description: This file defines the CommandContext class, which manages the processing and settlement (accept, release, modify, reject, disposition) of AMQP command messages, integrates with OpenTracing spans for tracing, and handles delivery state management for the Eclipse Hono client.

classes.name: CommandContext
classes.description: A class that encapsulates context information for processing a command message over AMQP, including methods for accepting, releasing, modifying, rejecting, and disclosing delivery states with integrated OpenTracing support.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a new CommandContext instance with provided command, delivery, receiver, and tracing span, ensuring none are null.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the command object associated with this context.

methods.name: getReceiver
methods.description: Returns the ProtonReceiver over which the command message was received.

methods.name: getDelivery
methods.description: Returns the ProtonDelivery object associated with the command message.

methods.name: getCurrentSpan
methods.description: Returns the OpenTracing span associated with this command processing.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts the command message with zero additional credits and finishes the tracing span.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts the command message with specified credits, flows credits if greater than zero, logs, and finishes the span.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the command message with zero credits.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the command message with specified credits, flows if necessary, logs, and finishes the span.

methods.name: modify
methods.description: Modifies the delivery with deliveryFailed and undeliverableHere flags, flows credits if needed, and finishes the span.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the message with no error condition and zero credits.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the message with a specified error condition, flows credits if needed, and finishes the span.

methods.name: disposition
methods.description: Sets the delivery disposition with a specified DeliveryState and zero credits.

methods.name: disposition
methods.description: Sets the delivery disposition with specified DeliveryState and credits, logs relevant info, and finishes the span.

methods.name: flow
methods.description: Issues credits to the sender if receiver's prefetch is zero, used internally.
